coverage_kind: route/interaction-family mapping, NOT 159 individually recreated or pixel-certified screens

flows.name: Onboarding
flows.implementation: Email-shaped input, sample-code entry/confirmation/error/expiry. No account creation.

flows.name: Starting a trial
flows.implementation: Offer dialog explicitly prevents checkout/enrollment. A global music trial is not a course product.

flows.name: New
flows.implementation: Landscape editorials, compact rows and square discovery shelves.

flows.name: Chart detail
flows.implementation: Curated collection/detail and ordered content, without fabricated popularity charts.

flows.name: Listening to songs
flows.implementation: Actual native local-video playback, pause, seeking and browser-tab position retention.

flows.name: Enabling shuffle
flows.implementation: No lesson shuffle. Curriculum remains ordered; user learning lists can be reordered separately.

flows.name: Repeating a song
flows.implementation: Repeat sample toggles the actual native video loop property.

flows.name: Expanding a song
flows.implementation: Focused media workspace and native fullscreen affordance; no persistent music mini-player.

flows.name: Favoriting a song
flows.implementation: Save/unsave in this browser tab, distinct from enrolled access.

flows.name: Adding to a library
flows.implementation: Fixture owned library and actual tab-only Saved are separate. No fake enrollment grant.

flows.name: Adding to a playlist
flows.implementation: More menu adds a sample course to a browser-tab learning list.

flows.name: Song credits
flows.implementation: More > About this sample explains fictional content and asset attribution.

flows.name: Hiding lyrics
flows.implementation: Switch study tabs away from Transcript; keep media context. No karaoke rendering.

flows.name: Showing lyrics
flows.implementation: Readable transcript, active cue and click-to-seek.

flows.name: Song queue
flows.implementation: Curriculum/up-next side panel with current lesson and next/previous links.

flows.name: Clearing song queue
flows.implementation: A purchased curriculum cannot be cleared. User learning lists support removal and confirmed deletion.

flows.name: Enabling autoplay
flows.implementation: Manual next lesson and repeat are implemented; continuous automatic cross-route playback is not.

flows.name: Adjusting volume
flows.implementation: Native browser volume control. The original sample is silent, so audible-volume behavior is not verified.

flows.name: Album detail
flows.implementation: Square cover, adjacent identity/offer/actions and ordered curriculum; visitor/learner/completed/unavailable states.

flows.name: Album description
flows.implementation: More about this course dialog with description, outcomes and prerequisites.

flows.name: Share an album
flows.implementation: Share dialog with a local preview URL and clear loopback limitations.

flows.name: Copying an album link
flows.implementation: Clipboard copy with permission-failure fallback. Link display never pretends to send a message.

flows.name: Artist detail
flows.implementation: Image-led creator identity, description, featured course and preview/course shelves.

flows.name: Nearby concerts
flows.implementation: Event/location family is demonstrated with conspicuously fictional workshops, not live-class availability.

flows.name: Marking a song as suggest less
flows.implementation: Explicit subject choices, More > Show less, and restore hidden suggestions. No recommendation service.

flows.name: Watching a music video
flows.implementation: Video-shaped preview gallery leading to the actual original local sample player.

flows.name: Search
flows.implementation: Search input, categories, recent queries, remove/clear and reset states.

flows.name: Searching Apple Music
flows.implementation: URL-driven course/creator results, subject/level/price/sort filters and empty results.

flows.name: Concerts
flows.implementation: Event-discovery layout, locations, dates, categories and empty filter state.

flows.name: Concert detail
flows.implementation: Date badge, circular image, event details, booking boundary and related events.

flows.name: Setting a location
flows.implementation: Explicit sample-location selection. No geolocation permission or real location service.

flows.name: Filtering concerts
flows.implementation: Real URL filters over fictional events; clear/reset/no matches.

flows.name: Replay monthly
flows.implementation: Monthly tabs, explicitly illustrative activity values and course/milestone shelves.

flows.name: Milestone detail
flows.implementation: Original milestone medallion and detail layout; explicitly not earned or a credential.

flows.name: Home
flows.implementation: Existing photo-led Home preserved; navigation now opens real implemented course destinations.

flows.name: Radio
flows.implementation: Subject-channel tiles, session rows and preview shelves; not a live-radio product.

flows.name: Listening to a live radio
flows.implementation: Channel preview opens an on-demand original clip, not a fake live broadcast.

flows.name: Live radio schedule
flows.implementation: Day selector and actual changing sample schedule; all availability explicitly fictional.

flows.name: Recently added
flows.implementation: Populated/empty sample library, list/grid, sort and search.

flows.name: Artists
flows.implementation: Creator identity grid and detail navigation; fictional identities, no invented credentials.

flows.name: Albums
flows.implementation: Square course-cover library and detail, not music albums.

flows.name: Songs
flows.implementation: Compact striped lesson table with course, creator, duration and current destinations.

flows.name: Sorting songs
flows.implementation: Keyboard-accessible sort menu and URL order; course/title/duration choices.

flows.name: Pinning a song
flows.implementation: Pin/unpin and empty/populated tab-only pinned lesson view.

flows.name: Music videos
flows.implementation: Landscape video-thumbnail library with sample-subject filter.

flows.name: Made for you
flows.implementation: Empty state and explicit-interest course selection, independently from owned/saved courses.

flows.name: All playlists
flows.implementation: Learning-list mosaic grid, new-list dialog and empty list.

flows.name: Playlist detail
flows.implementation: List title/description, course rows, edit, reorder, remove and confirmed delete.

flows.name: Adding a suggested song
flows.implementation: Add suggested sample course; updates list membership in this tab only.

flows.name: Favorite songs
flows.implementation: Saved courses are bookmarks, not favorites-based paid access.

flows.name: Editing library menus
flows.implementation: Library navigation Edit/Done, checkboxes and reversible tab-only visibility preferences.

flows.name: Logging out
flows.implementation: Return to visitor preview; no real session exists to revoke. Not advertised as an actual sign-out.

flows.name: Settings
flows.implementation: Account-summary/access/preferences sections, profile-edit dialog, caption preference and purchase empty state.

flows.name: Connected accounts
flows.implementation: Connected-accounts dialog explains no real accounts; provider linking is disabled.

flows.name: Turning on content restrictions
flows.implementation: Public sample-code entry, confirmation/error, switch and result filter. Not parental controls or security.

flows.name: Canceling a trial
flows.implementation: No subscription/trial exists to cancel. No fake cancellation, refund, or payment success.

flows.name: Changing language
flows.implementation: Language selection dialog switches this study between English and Simplified Chinese with real query navigation.

flows.name: Logging in
flows.implementation: Email/code interface and recovery; explicit no email, no verified identity, no session, no entitlement.
